description: Settle an invoice using the account BALANCE (not a card — the balance you build with impreza_topup). Fails with INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE when the balance is short: top up the difference first, then call this again. Use impreza_list_invoices with status="Unpaid" to find the invoice_id. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. COSTS MONEY — takes two calls: the first is a QUOTE that charges nothing and returns the price plus a confirm_token, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and buys. Purchases also count against a daily spend ceiling on the credential.
name: impreza_pay_invoice
title: Pay invoice from balance
